proposed_comments.body:
### Don't restore the multi-byte native title without a round-trip guard

**Severity:** `high`

Seeding an ASCII fallback before `SetTitleBar()` closes the empty-title race, but the later issue 49880 investigation shows the affected WinUI desktop windows are ANSI (`IsWindowUnicode == FALSE`) in the non-elevated path. Reassigning the localized or administrator title back to the native window here can still truncate the first CJK character on normal launches, and the elevated path can still hit the WinUI fail-fast when the UTF-16 title length changes across the deferred read-back. Please keep the native window title on a safe fallback until WinUI finishes consuming it, or add an explicit round-trip or length guard before restoring the localized title. The same pattern appears in the other updated windows in this PR.
